newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent Chicago premium unleaded firms.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent Chicago premium unleaded firms.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent premium unleaded gasoline differentials rose on Monday on tightened stocks tied to refinery turnarounds in the Chicago region, traders said.
"There are a lot of process units down, and everybody just sort of ran out of inventory that had been laying around," one Midwest trader active in the Chicago market said.

Shell's 268,000 barrel per day Wood River Ill., refinery, Marathon's 175,000 barrel per day Robinson, Ill., refinery and Mobil's 188,000 barrel per day Joliet, Ill., refinery each had units in turnaround, traders said.
Premium unleaded in Chicago was talked 6 cents a gallon over regular unleaded for all April timings, with regular unleaded trading at even to 0.25 cent a gallon over NYMEX May unleaded, traders said.
Group Three unleaded was talked 1.0/0.75 cent a gallon under the print, with premium 3.50 cents higher.
Low sulphur diesel was bid 6.75 cents a gallon over NYMEX May heating oil in Group Three and 4.75 cents over the print in Chicago.
High sulphur was talked 6.75/7.0 cents a gallon over the print in Group Three and 3.0/3.25 cents over in Chicago.
